title: What closing price would put daily RSI at 30? A check for an AI-generated rule
author: Prior_Bat5628
selftext:
If an AI writes “buy when RSI(14) is below 30,” ask it to work one example by hand before you trust the backtest.



Suppose yesterday closed at $100. The 14-day Wilder averages of gains and losses were both exactly $0.30. If today closes at $94.80, the smoothed gain becomes (13 × $0.30) ÷ 14 and the smoothed loss becomes (13 × $0.30 + $5.20) ÷ 14. Their ratio is 3/7, which gives an RSI of exactly 30. A strict “below 30” condition needs a close under $94.80 in this example.



That calculation lets you test the signal. The execution assumption is separate. If the rule uses the completed close, ask the backtest to show the next eligible fill and its price. A signal at the close and a fill at that same price require different assumptions.



I ran the daily preset on SPY from Nov 22, 2021 to Nov 20, 2026 with next-open entries and a five-session hold. The rule returned +50.9% after modeled costs versus +57.7% holding, with seven simulated trades. The small sample is another reason I’d inspect the signal and fill before drawing a conclusion.
